question: Who among the following is the author of the novel 'Red Earth and Pouring Rain'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vikram Chandra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vikram Chandra is an **Indian-American writer.**
 
• His** first novel, Red Earth and Pouring Rain,** won the** 1996 Commonwealth writer prize for Best First Book.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Suketu Mehta**

 
 
• He is a **New York-based author** of the book** Maximum City.**
 
• **Finalist for the 2005 Pulitzer prize.**
 
 
 
• **Arundhati Roy** 
 
 
• She is an **Indian author, **actress, and political activist.
 
• She wrote the noble** The God of small things (1997), which won the Booker prize.**
